meta.description: Prepare a bulletin, retry a transient compliance lookup, and require explicit approval before publication.

argv:
python3 - <<'PY'
import json
import pathlib

source_note = pathlib.Path("{params.source_note}")
if not source_note.is_file():
    raise SystemExit("source_note is not a file: " + str(source_note))

text = source_note.read_text().strip()
if not text:
    raise SystemExit("source_note is empty: " + str(source_note))

lines = [line.rstrip() for line in text.splitlines() if line.strip()]
out_dir = pathlib.Path("../outputs/prepare")
out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
payload = dict(
    title="{params.bulletin_title}",
    source_name=source_note.name,
    summary=lines[0],
    detail_lines=lines[1:],
)
(out_dir / "bulletin.json").write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=2) + "\n")
PY

python3 - <<'PY'
import json
import pathlib

plan_path = pathlib.Path("{params.retry_plan}")
if not plan_path.is_file():
    raise SystemExit("retry_plan is not a file: " + str(plan_path))

plan = json.loads(plan_path.read_text())
state_dir = plan_path.parent / ".compliance-gate-state"
state_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
attempt_path = state_dir / "fetch-attempts.txt"
attempt = int(attempt_path.read_text()) + 1 if attempt_path.exists() else 1
attempt_path.write_text(str(attempt))
fail_until = int(plan.get("fail_until_attempt", 0))
if attempt <= fail_until:
    raise SystemExit(f"transient compliance gate lookup failed on attempt {attempt}")

bulletin = json.loads(pathlib.Path("../inputs/prepare_bulletin_input/bulletin").read_text())
out_dir = pathlib.Path("../outputs/gate")
out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
payload = {
    "attempt": attempt,
    "gate_policy": plan.get("gate_policy", "manual-approval"),
    "expected_reviewer_group": plan.get("expected_reviewer_group", "release-managers"),
    "bulletin_summary": bulletin["summary"]
}
(out_dir / "gate_snapshot.json").write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=2) + "\n")
PY

python3 - <<'PY'
import json
import pathlib

gate = json.loads(pathlib.Path("../inputs/fetch_compliance_gate/gate").read_text())
approval_path = pathlib.Path("{params.publication_gate}")
if not approval_path.is_file():
    raise SystemExit("publication_gate is not a file: " + str(approval_path))

approval = json.loads(approval_path.read_text())
if not approval.get("approved"):
    raise SystemExit("publication gate is not approved")
reviewer = approval.get("reviewer", "").strip()
if not reviewer:
    raise SystemExit("publication gate reviewer is missing")
reviewer_group = approval.get("reviewer_group", "").strip()
expected_group = gate["expected_reviewer_group"]
if reviewer_group != expected_group:
    raise SystemExit(
        f"publication gate reviewer_group mismatch: expected {expected_group}, got {reviewer_group or 'missing'}"
    )

out_dir = pathlib.Path("../outputs/approval")
out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
payload = {
    "approved": True,
    "reviewer": reviewer,
    "reviewer_group": reviewer_group,
    "gate_policy": gate["gate_policy"],
    "gate_attempt": gate["attempt"]
}
(out_dir / "approval.json").write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=2) + "\n")
PY

python3 - <<'PY'
import json
import pathlib

bulletin = json.loads(pathlib.Path("../inputs/prepare_bulletin_input/bulletin").read_text())
approval = json.loads(pathlib.Path("../inputs/validate_publication_gate/approval").read_text())
lines = [
    "# " + bulletin["title"],
    "",
    "Source note: " + bulletin["source_name"],
    "Summary: " + bulletin["summary"],
    "Approved by: " + approval["reviewer"],
    "Reviewer group: " + approval["reviewer_group"],
    "Gate lookup attempt: " + str(approval["gate_attempt"]),
]
if bulletin["detail_lines"]:
    lines.extend(["", "## Detail"])
    lines.extend("- " + line for line in bulletin["detail_lines"])

out_dir = pathlib.Path("../outputs/publish")
out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
(out_dir / "bulletin.md").write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n")
(out_dir / "publication.json").write_text(json.dumps({
    "approved_by": approval["reviewer"],
    "gate_lookup_attempt": approval["gate_attempt"],
    "source_name": bulletin["source_name"]
}, indent=2) + "\n")
